# OpenSocrates 1.1.2

OpenSocrates 1.1.2 closes the gap between selecting a reasoning method and
actually reading its authored procedure in Claude Code and Cowork.

## Highlights

- Claude now records an authenticated, owner-only receipt only when the exact
  current-turn instruction file is read from its first line through a terminal
  marker. A partial, truncated, failed, or wrong-file read is not accepted.
- If Claude tries to finish without that receipt, the `Stop` hook requests one
  bounded repair pass. It also verifies that the response ends with the exact
  `OpenSocrates grounding: method-id@content-revision` audit line.
- Selected method IDs and content revisions are explicit. Authored
  `Do not use when` and `Stop conditions` are also placed in trusted hook
  context when they fit, so the most important blocking rules apply even before
  the full procedure read completes.
- Grounding receipts contain no prompt, transcript, tool output, credential,
  workspace path, or artifact path. The full Read response is inspected only
  in memory and the receipt is deleted with the temporary turn artifact.

## Upgrade notes

Update both managed hosts together with:

```bash
npx --yes opensocrates@1.1.2 update --host all
```

The grounding completion gate is enabled for Claude surfaces that deliver the
packaged hooks. Claude Chat remains skills-only, and unavailable hooks continue
to fail open instead of blocking the user's task.
